Pegasus_Feathered_Wings.description: The Pegasus Feathered Wings are a marvel of nature and magic, sprouting from the back of an otherwise equine form, granting the creature unparalleled aerial prowess and a swift, nimble stride on the ground, enhancing its natural agility and speed with each beat of its powerful, feathered membranes.

Demon_Boar_Leathery_Wings.description: The Demon Boar's leathery wings, a grotesque appendage of armored scales and sinew, enable it to take to the skies with a heavy, thunderous flap, granting it formidable natural armor and enhanced strength, while also bestowing it with the skills to resist wind and deliver devastating charges.

Golden_Fleece_Gliders.description: Borne upon gossamer wings tipped with gleaming gold, the Golden Fleece Gliders are graceful ungulates that soar through the twilight skies, their presence imbued with an otherworldly charisma and an innate magic that grants them both the charm to captivate and the aerobatic prowess to dance among the clouds.

Alit_Vestigial_Wings.description: Emerging from the creature's back are delicate, yet resilient, vestigial wings, remnants of a once-flight-capable ancestor, now serving to enhance its agility and provide a remarkable leap ability, granting it a fleeting, yet graceful advantage in the treacherous landscapes of the dark fantasy realm.

Nightmare_Steed_Flaming_Wings.description: Emblazoned with fiery wings that cast an eerie glow, the Nightmare Steed's flaming appendages pulse with malevolent magic, its presence striking fear and awe into the hearts of all who behold it, while its agility and charm make it a formidable steed in the skies.

Hippogriff_Avian_Wings.description: Enveloped in a shimmering coat of midnight feathers and sturdy, powerful talons, the Hippogriff_Avian_Wings component grants the creature unparalleled aerial prowess, enhancing its speed and agility as it cuts through the sky with deadly precision, its keen eyes locking onto targets from dizzying heights.

Deer_Fae_Gossamer_Wings.description: Gossamer wings of vibrant hues, like the fleeting whispers of dawn and dusk, sprout from the slender shoulders of the deer fae, granting them the ethereal grace to soar through the air with uncanny agility and the mystic power to cloak themselves in invisibility.

Bison_Stout_Gliding_Membranes.description: Enormous and hulking, the Bison_Stout_Gliding_Membranes boasts a pair of thick, leathery wings that sprout from its sturdy shoulders, allowing it to glide gracefully through the air despite its heavy build, while its powerful legs and increased constitution make it a formidable opponent in both aerial and terrestrial combat.

Zombie_Steed_Rotting_Wings.description: Tattered and corrupted wings, once the proud appendages of an ancient ungulate, now flap weakly, carrying the stench of decay and poison through the air, marking the steed as a harbinger of toxic chaos in the skies.

Ghost_Kirins_Spectral_Wings.description: Emerging from the spectral essence of the ghost kirin, these translucent wings are a haunting marvel, blending the ethereal with the arcane, granting the creature both flight and the ability to hover mid-air with ghostly grace.
